title: Convert a reaction-wide value to a sample
statement:
A written gas reaction produces two moles of product and is estimated to release 174 kJ. How much signed heat corresponds to 0.500 mol product?

[_]{a}

explanations: This gives the per-mole value, not the half-mole heat.
This doubles the written reaction rather than reducing it.

hints: Treat the estimate as per written reaction.
solution: Treat the estimate as per written reaction. Determine the fraction 0.500/2. Preserve the release sign. Multiply −174 by one quarter.
